39/S0.subgoal: Describe the three broad categories of interaction used in immersive experiences.

39/S1.subgoal: Explain the parameters that determine the suitable selection technique in a virtual experience.

39/S2.subgoal: Identify the major types of object selection techniques.

39/S3.subgoal: Compare traditional and advanced methods for selecting objects using hands in a virtual world.

39/S4.subgoal: Describe various methods for performing selection by pointing in a virtual world.

39/S5.subgoal: Explain how image plane and volumetric techniques allow for selecting 2D or 3D regions in virtual space.

39/S6.subgoal: Describe hand-based and indirect methods used to modify virtual object properties.

39/S7.subgoal: Differentiate between various techniques involving dual-hand and integrated manipulation.
